summary: A ghost Button's hover is visible on an elevated surface. Its hover fill is the sheet's --ui-bg-elevated, drawn on the page, so inside any surface that already paints bg-elevated — a Card, a Chat Tasks card, the run dock, a lane pill, a popover panel — the hover was the ground's own colour (1.00:1) and nothing happened. Inside an ancestor that paints bg-elevated the ghost now steps to --ui-bg-hover, the next rung of the interaction ramp that the token test holds past elevated in every seed and both schemes; on the page it is unchanged. Asserted in a real hover, both schemes, as the hovered fill DIFFERING from its ground, which failed on the old code. The class reader shared by check:utilities, check:strokes, check:type-roles and check:token-consumers did not know Tailwind's `in-*` variant and skipped such classes whole — probed with a typo that stayed green — and now strips it.
